verdict.rationale: Linear's Customer Requests feature attaches customer feedback to the issues and projects customers asked for, and lets you filter those issues and projects by customer data. That covers linking feedback to roadmap work items such as projects. The evidence never mentions linking requests to initiatives or releases. Missing for 10: documented linking of feedback to initiatives, documented linking to releases, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can link feedback requests to roadmap features, initiatives, and releases

citations.quote: Understand customer use-cases directly on the issues and projects they’ve asked for
View and filter issues or projects by customer name, count, status, tier revenue, and size to identify high impact customer work
